latest.title: Circle Pushes Back on MiCA's Bank-Deposit Mandate for Stablecoins
latest.description: The USDC issuer told the European Commission that MiCA's reserve mandates and concentration caps keep the largest global stablecoins outside Europe's perimeter—siding with the ECB in calling for more flexible rules.

latest.title: G7 nations to release diesel stocks as wars in Europe and Middle East constrain fuel supplies
latest.description: EU countries are set for crisis talks on soaring diesel prices, with officials warning a U.S. export ban could hurt Europe’s economic outlook.

latest.title: FAA says Boeing 737 Max software glitch not a flight-safety issue
latest.description: The FAA on Monday said it was reviewing the software glitch, which could affect procedures during certain landings.

latest.title: This AI Is Already Fooling People on Video Calls Into Thinking Its Human, Company Says
latest.description: Tavus says 26 of 54 people on a one-minute video call thought its new Griffin model was human. The results are the company's own, and the model isn't going to retail customers yet.

latest.title: How AI is redefining Wall Street jobs — and boosting demand for this new 'hottest skill' by 1,721%
